title: Load Balancer vs Application Gateway
description: Choose between Azure Load Balancer and Application Gateway for traffic distribution.

data.text: You have 4 VMs hosting a web API. You need to distribute traffic evenly, support HTTPS termination, and protect against OWASP Top 10 attacks. Should you use Azure Load Balancer or Application Gateway?
Use **Azure Application Gateway** for layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) load balancing with WAF. Use **Azure Load Balancer** for layer 4 (TCP/UDP) load balancing without HTTP features.

data.title: Azure CLI - Create Application Gateway with WAF
data.code:
az network application-gateway create \
  --name 'agw-prod' \
  --resource-group 'rg-network' \
  --vnet-name 'vnet-prod' \
  --subnet 'snet-agw' \
  --capacity 2 \
  --sku WAF_v2 \
  --http-settings-protocol Https \
  --http-settings-port 443 \
  --frontend-port 443 \
  --waf-policy 'waf-policy'

data.text: **Application Gateway** operates at layer 7, enabling URL-based routing, SSL termination, and WAF. **Load Balancer** is layer 4 only. For web apps, Application Gateway is almost always the right choice.
